note: Cell address arithmetic, range expansion and the two resizes, asked of both engines. A resize answers the whole object because a resize moves cell slots about, and the order they come back in is observable. A dimension slot that holds a formula, a number that is not whole, a negative number or text all read as no lines at all, and the cases here carry each of those, because a table that declared cells from a size evaluation had yet to settle would break the rule that evaluation never changes the slot set.
